test-code.description: no violation: Gson in companion object val - created once
no violation: Gson as top-level val - created once
test-code.code:
import com.google.gson.Gson
private val GSON = Gson() // good - top-level val, created once
fun toJson(obj: Any): String = GSON.toJson(obj)

import com.google.gson.Gson
fun toJson(obj: Any): String = Gson().toJson(obj) // bad - top-level function
